hypotheses.paper: Σ a compact Riemannian manifold with boundary
hypotheses.note: CompactSpace, T2Space, IsManifold (𝓡∂ N) ∞ M, smooth g; every N ≥ 1 (NeZero N), the paper's N ≥ 3 is not needed
every IsLocallyLebesgue μ (OQ-93 (a)); its finiteness is derived

questions: l.720 says « the trace operator W^{1,2}(Σ) → L²(∂Σ) is compact ». The library has no W^{1,2}(Σ) and no trace operator, so the reading taken is round 1's: every sequence of C¹ functions bounded in the W^{1,2} norm has a subsequence whose restrictions to ∂M converge in L²(σ) to some f with MemLp f 2 σ. This is OQ-93 (b), still open; no new reading was added. The limit f is not identified as the trace of the L²(μ) limit, which needs a W^{1,2} space; the proof of lem:positivity identifies it through the constancy step and needs only the continuity of the trace (Yamabe.Trace, SCOPE).

kb_proposals: pitfall: the library never proves |∇u|_g = Mfd.gradNorm measurable, so a W^{1,2} bound of u − w cannot be derived from w12 u and w12 w: eLpNorm_add_le needs AEStronglyMeasurable, and the lower lintegral of a non-measurable function is not subadditive. Split the derivative term in the chart, where fderivWithin of chartFun (ρu) is continuous on ℍ̄ (fderivWithin_sub, then eLpNorm_sub_le), and state the estimate for differences (Yamabe.Mfd.local_trace_interp, trace_interp_sub).

pattern: Mfd.assemble_family is Mfd.assemble for a family of right-hand sides R j with one constant for all j. Index it by a subtype of parameter tuples, e.g. {j : ℝ × (M → ℝ) × (M → ℝ) // 0 < j.1 ∧ IsC1 N j.2.1 ∧ IsC1 N j.2.2}, so that the constant does not depend on δ (Yamabe.Mfd.trace_interp_sub).

pattern: the q = 2 trace on the half-space with the gradient over ℍ̄ only. Apply trace_halfSpace to w = Half.ext v ∘ Half.Φ n. Bound |∂_t w p| by ‖Half.extD v (Φ p)‖ at every p: extD is continuous, so no measurability is lost, and it equals fderivWithin v ℍ̄ on ℍ̄. Pass to ℍ̄ by lintegral_mono_set and MeasurePreserving.setLIntegral_comp_preimage_emb, with (Φ n).toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding (Yamabe.Half.trace_interp_halfSpace).

pattern: from an interpolation inequality to an L²(σ) limit. Use EMetric.cauchySeq_iff with Lp.edist_toLp_toLp, then ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_real_btwn to get a real r, choosing δ against the W^{1,2} bound before the index. Conclude with cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete and Lp.tendsto_Lp_iff_tendsto_eLpNorm', as RellichCriterion does (Yamabe.Mfd.trace_compact).
pitfall: at this pin mul_le_mul_left' is deprecated for mul_le_mul_right : b ≤ c → ∀ a, a * b ≤ a * c (multiplier on the left despite the name; compare kb 0041).
notes: Mfd.trace_compact is proved in place: the statement is unchanged (git diff touches only the docstring and the proof), sorry-free, axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. The same holds for every declaration of TraceInterp.lean. Both files typecheck under -DwarningAsError=true, so graduation is a file move. TraceCompact.lean now imports YamabeScaffold.TraceInterp. At graduation, move TraceInterp.lean to Yamabe/TraceInterp.lean and rename the import to Yamabe.TraceInterp. The scaffold root YamabeScaffold.lean reaches TraceInterp only transitively; the master may list it there. `lake build YamabeScaffold.TraceCompact` built only TraceInterp and TraceCompact; no Yamabe.* or mathlib module was rebuilt. The docstrings mark no label: trace_compact is one step of lem:positivity's proof (l.720) under the readings of OQ-93, and nothing uses it. The route was the dispatch's, with one change. The interpolation is ‖u − w‖_{L²(σ)} ≤ C(δ(w12 u + w12 w) + δ⁻¹‖u − w‖_{L²(μ)}), linear in δ, in difference form for the reason in kb_proposals[0]. It holds for every N ≥ 1 and every boundary measure, and the single-function form is Mfd.trace_interp.
